title: APS Core
description: Alpha Pokemon Statue - Tool for generating pokemon statues from other APS Pack
body:
_Alpha Pokemon Statues (APS) is a set of created and upcoming datapacks that generate Pokemon Alpha based on the biomes. The more pack you add, the more random in the generation._

This datapack is the engine of the APS generation and allows you to connect and generate the statues of the different APS packs ! From this pack, add the different APS packs to create a unique and customized experience !
